author: SkeletonJoe456
body:
The server was amazing when I started in 2013, about three years ago. It was a time when the game was fun. I loved the server, then my minecraft broke. I wasn't on for a long time, then, when I return, everything is gone. My favorite server, was shriveled up and crushed while I was gone. I have no idea what happened, but I know that whatever did destroyed Senex, ruined half of the maps, got rid of the spanky spade, and drove away half of the players. I honestly loved the server before, but now, now, the players are a bunch of five year old trolls, the community is rotten to the core, and my favorite map, senex, oh senex, the map I would play after a hard day, and it would perk my day right up, was SOILED. Anybody reading this that joined in 2013-14 would know what I mean my the downfall of Avicus. This message, is not me hating on the server, its not me trying to be mean, it is just... I have to let this out, my... outrage that I have for the new Avicus! I honestly love the server, but not what it has become, so I will be much less active, and if you never see SkeletonJoe456 on Avicus again at some point, this is why. Goodbye, old friends, goodbye Avicus.



                                                                                                          -SkeletonJoe456
